news.title: Everything you need to know about the CAF Strategy Conference: Dates, venue and key issues
news.lede: The Confédération Africaine de Football (CAF) will bring together leading decision-makers, coaches and football experts in Cape Verde in October for a landmark Strategy Conference aimed at shaping the next phase of African football development. The three-day gathering will take place from 7 to 9 October 2026 in Santa Maria, Sal Island, and will be convened under the leadership of CAF President Dr Patrice Motsepe. The Conference comes after Africa’s record participation at the FIFA World Cup 2026, where 10 national teams represented the continent and nine progressed to the knockout stages. Their performances will form an important part of discussions as CAF examines what worked, what can be improved and how African teams can become even more competitive by the FIFA World Cup 2030.

news.title: Lionel Messi Set for Final Argentina Farewell in Match Against Benin
news.lede: Argentine Maestro to Bid Farewell Against Benin After More Than Two Decades of Glory. Lionel Messi will bring the curtain down on his glittering Argentina career on Tuesday with a farewell friendly against Benin that marks the dawn of a new era for the South American champions. After more than two decades of service to his country, the 39-year-old superstar will hand over the captain's armband for good as he makes his final appearance in the Albiceleste jersey at the Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires. Messi will be joined for his international swansong by 85,000 spectators and several of the teammates with whom he reached the pinnacle of football at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, alongside members of Argentina's emerging generation.

news.title: CAF Strategy Conference: Carlos Queiroz – five World Cups and a Ghana campaign with lessons for Africa
news.lede: Carlos Queiroz will arrive at the CAF Strategy Conference in Cabo Verde only days after his spell as Ghana coach came to an end, but carrying with him another chapter in one of international football’s most travelled coaching careers. The 73-year-old mutually ended his agreement with the Ghana Football Association on 1 October, just weeks after being handed a new mandate following the FIFA World Cup 2026. Despite leaving the Black Stars, Queiroz will still attend the Conference in Sal to share the experience of guiding Ghana through one of the most demanding groups at the World Cup and into the knockout stage for the first time since 2010.

news.title: Diego Forlan On Rebuilding Uruguay: 'When You Win, You're Not The Best'
news.lede: Uruguay head coach Diego Forlan discusses the team's recent World Cup group-stage exits, emphasising the need for calm and confidence in rebuilding the squad. He highlights his philosophy of hard work, adaptability, and playing good football, while acknowledging the pressure of managing a national team with a rich history. Forlan also reflects on his initial games as coach and the importance of team cohesion.

news.title: Messi set for Argentina farewell against Benin
news.lede: BUENOS AIRES: Lionel Messi will end his Argentina career on Tuesday with a farewell friendly against Benin, which marks the start of a new era for the South American champions. After more than two decades with the national team, the 39-year-old will hand over the captain's armband for good in his final appearance in the Albiceleste shirt at the Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires. Messi will be joined by 85,000 spectators and several teammates from the 2022 World Cup triumph in Qatar, along with members of Argentina's emerging generation. His international record includes a World Cup title, two Copa America titles and the Finalissima.

news.title: Preparations for FIFA U-15 World Cup in Baku Near Completion
news.lede: Preparations for the first FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival, set to take place in Baku, are nearing completion. According to Offsideplus.az, the prestigious tournament, scheduled for October 22-30, is expected to see the participation of nearly 4,000 young footballers, coaches, and officials from around 190 countries. The vast majority of the nearly 1,000 matches will be held at the 10 football pitches of the newly constructed Hovsan Sports Complex. The opening and final matches of the tournament will take place at the Baku Crystal Hall.
